audit.why: Emerald+ 57.26% over 475 games is the best number in the slice by a wide margin, and the page does not oversell it — both charts still give Quinn Level 6 and the scaling stages because her win condition is leaving the lane rather than beating Jayce in it. That is the right read for a 57% lane you can still lose on the map.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three separate strings build the plan around 'her Vault cooldown' and never give the number, and Heightened Senses is absent from the matchup entirely.
audit.why: Vault is 12/11/10/9/8 at 675 range — twelve seconds at rank 1 is the actual all-in window every one of those strings gestures at. Heightened Senses is 50/45/40/35/30 with a 2100-range reveal, and its absence matters more than a poke ability would: at fifty seconds it is the reason a Quinn who is about to leave lane can check the river first, and it is the tell that a roam is coming. Blinding Assault is 11s at 1025 range, which is longer than most players expect and is the range she actually pokes from.
audit.corrected: Vault 12s at rank 1 is the all-in window; Blinding Assault 11s at 1025; Heightened Senses 50s and a 2100-range reveal that precedes her roams.

audit.whatIsWrong: `wants.foe[0]`, `spikes[3].text` and `late` all describe Vault as a knockback that 'knocks you out of' or 'breaks' your Hammer engage. Vault does not displace you.
audit.why: Riot's Vault: 'Quinn dashes to an enemy, dealing physical damage and slowing the target's Move Speed. Upon reaching the target, she leaps off the target, briefly interrupting it, and lands near her.' The displacement is hers, not yours — she ends up behind you and you stay where you were. What it does to you is an interrupt and a slow. That changes the counterplay completely: against a knockback you brace for distance, against an interrupt you make sure you have no channel or dash mid-flight when she commits, and you keep in mind that she ends the cast on the far side of you, which is where your Thundering Blow needs to be aimed.
audit.corrected: Vault interrupts and slows you and repositions HER behind you — it is not a knockback.

audit.why: The blind claim is right and is the best line on the page. Blinding Assault marks and blinds, and Hyper Charge is a burst of attack speed spent on basic attacks — so a blind lands on exactly the ability the player is most likely to have just spent. Keeping that stated is worth more than any addition here.

notes: The recurring error here is that Vault is written as a knockback in three places. It is not: Riot's text has Quinn leap off the target, briefly interrupting it, and land near her — she moves, you do not, and you get an interrupt plus a slow. The practical consequence is worth the edit on its own, because Thundering Blow needs to be aimed at where she ends up, which is behind you. Heightened Senses (50s at rank 1, 2100-range reveal) appears nowhere in this matchup and is the best available tell that she is about to roam bot — I put it in the cooldown block. This matchup's `early`, `mid` and `late` are written in FIRST person like the Mordekaiser one; I converted the two strings I rewrote to second person, but `early`, `mid` and four remaining `whys` still say 'I' and 'my'.
